mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which can stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when UNRATE crosses above 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not higher when HOUST exceeds 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher when INDPRO exceeds 102.

mechanism_narrative: Both retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) increasing together signal strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when both RSAFS and HOUST cross their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE) signals a specific monetary policy stance, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher when FEDFUNDS is low and UNRATE is high.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a tightening cycle signals higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.15 during tightening.
